svg.title: Substitution of Ifree d,d+1v proves exact compatibility with the adjacent inclusion, hence with every inclusion by composition. Induction in d, using (WS5), gives U−1 k,dXk,d →1. Consequently these maps are eventually isomorphisms, preserve the unit and symmetries, and still satisfy the second line of (WS5). On the finitely many exceptional indices choose any isomorphisms; these choices do not affect a limit. Conjugation by matrices tending to the identity preserves all the finite-dimensional limits just obtained.
